judge.summary: The AI made a necessary support request, retained ownership, resumed naturally with a relevant simulator-fixture-backed option, and continued selling toward a viewing. The buyer became appointment-ready and the AI handed off at the correct time with NONE/LOW sales work remaining. The formal handoff was successful under the AI outcome definition, but the separate human operational task was not completed: no viewing slots or booking were available in the fixture. The unit, availability, and RM418,000 package are simulator-only evidence, not Pearlmont Knowledge or a real-world listing.

improvement_recommendation.recommendation: Keep the support-enabled sales flow, but avoid promising available viewing times when the operational connection is unavailable. Frame the next step as asking the operations contact to check, and clearly distinguish a completed booking from an unresolved check.
